title: myrteola oxycoccoides
intro: Myrteola oxycoccoides, commonly known as the New Zealand cranberry, is a flowering plant native to New Zealand. It is valued for its health benefits, which include the potential to support urinary tract health and aid in the prevention of kidney stones. The therapeutic actions of Myrteola oxycoccoides include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the urinary tract system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
